name: elephantopin
summary: Sesquiterpene lactone from Elephantopus species with NF-κB inhibitory and immunomodulatory activity. Related to deoxyelephantopin. Preclinical evidence only; no established human use as isolated compound.
description: Elephantopin, a sesquiterpene lactone, is associated with regulation of inflammatory signaling cascades that can influence stress-response transcription.
safetyNotes: Mostly preclinical or source-extract evidence. Isolated-compound safety is not equivalent to food/herb exposure; use caution with pregnancy, liver/kidney disease, and polypharmacy.
dosage: standardized extract or essential-oil-free preparation when oral use is intended
typical_dosage: standardized extract or essential-oil-free preparation when oral use is intended
evidence_grade_explanation: Both evidence signals agree on limited evidence.
evidence_rationale: No study design has been recorded for this profile yet.
